title: Section 7.5.3 degree-radius interaction grid
subtitle: Disk support, arcs/S-curves/steps, precomputed-kernel FFT application, clean local-patch evaluation

config.apparatus_reduction: Metrics are measured on centered local patches rather than full 1024^2 frames. The support radius never exceeds 50 px, the evaluation masks are confined to local tangent-normal neighborhoods, and each tiled FFT canvas fully contains every neighborhood that can influence the reported errors.

metrics.arc_grad_rmse: Mean gradient-vector RMSE over circular arcs only.
metrics.step_grad_rmse: Mean gradient-vector RMSE over smoothed step edges.
metrics.kappa_design_matrix: Condition number sigma_max / sigma_min of the weighted design matrix.
metrics.rank_deficient_count: Number of singular values below the scaled-epsilon pseudoinverse cutoff.
metrics.sigma_min: Smallest singular value of the design matrix.

config.recommendation_rule: At each radius, max useful degree is the largest degree with rank_deficient_count == 0.
